title: Build Fast, Govern Better
deckTitle: Build Fast, Govern Better: The Latest in Power Apps code apps and Copilot Managed Runtime for devs
summary: Writing code is the easy part. The Managed Host closes the gap between AI-generated apps and enterprise-ready ones: build anywhere, IT always governs.
whyItMatters: Defines how AI-built apps become governed enterprise apps, and the roadmap for code apps vs CMR.

keyPoints.heading: CLI and SDK
keyPoints.text: SDK: client library app code calls for connectors/Dataverse/sign-in. CLI: create/connect/publish, inline connections, governance metadata; coding agent plugin with create-app skill.

keyPoints.heading: Code apps updates
keyPoints.text: Richer Dataverse integration, embedded Copilot Studio agents, service principal deployments.

keyPoints.heading: Managed Host
keyPoints.text: CSP (configured in Microsoft admin center), assets behind Entra-authenticated gateway (~November), hourly Monitor alerts.

keyPoints.heading: Secure by default
keyPoints.text: Sharing limits, security groups, connection consent, Advanced Connector Policies (environment or group level in PPAC), CSP, Purview logs; Conditional Access coming.

keyPoints.heading: Code apps next (early 2027)
keyPoints.text: Copilot side pane, Cowork hand-off, deep links, biweekly office hours.

keyPoints.heading: CMR next
keyPoints.text: GA; native Cowork integration; integrated data with RBAC (preview); server-side logic (preview) - CMR only, not code apps.

keyPoints.heading: Deployment targets
keyPoints.text: New target = copy of production with its own URL (e.g., test), pointable at a different data source.

keyPoints.heading: Code apps or CMR
keyPoints.text: Start with either; code apps SDK mostly a subset of CMR. CMR uses Git ALM; end users need Copilot Credits or Power Apps premium.
